outcome: Female Sexual Function Index (FSFI) score (sexual function)
Day-to-day Impact on Vaginal Aging (DIVA) questionnaire (genitourinary symptoms)
Interest in use of vaginal lubricants
cohort: The study included 125 women 5-6 months postpartum following singleton delivery, divided into groups based on whether they were primarily breastfeeding or primarily formula feeding.
finding: Primarily breastfeeding women had significantly lower FSFI scores, indicating poorer sexual function, compared to primarily formula feeding women.
